title: Sheet-pan pizza made with a spoon — 16×12 in (40×30 cm)
setup: Use a bowl, spoon or spatula, plastic wrap, a rectangular sheet pan and a colander.
The topping has ONE 25 g oil allowance (2 tbsp total), used partly in the sauce and partly for drizzling. The two oil-use rows are not two full quantities.

ingredients.text: Dough: fresh brewer’s yeast — 10 g (0.4 oz)
Dough: extra virgin olive oil — 30 g (2 tbsp)
Pan: extra virgin olive oil — as needed
Topping oil, use A: about half of the listed 25 g (2 tbsp total)
Topping oil, use B: a little more from that SAME 25 g total, for drizzling
Fior di latte mozzarella — 250 g (9 oz)

steps.action: Mix the flour, yeast and water in a bowl with a spoon or spatula until sticky.
Cover with plastic wrap and rest for 10 minutes.
Add the dough oil and salt, then mix again with a spoon or spatula.
Cover and rest for another 10 minutes.
Fold in the bowl with a spatula: lift the edges and bring them to the center. The dough becomes smoother.
Cover with plastic wrap; let rise at 77–81°F (25–27°C) for about 3 hours, or until doubled.
Grease a 16×12 in (40×30 cm) rectangular pan.
Turn the risen dough into the greased pan and start spreading it with your hands.
Cover again and rest for 10 minutes. Prepare the topping during this rest.
Meanwhile, mix the tomato purée, oregano, topping salt and about half the topping oil.
Retrieve the dough and spread it further with your fingers.
Spread the prepared topping over the dough.
Drizzle with a little more of the topping oil and rest for half an hour.
Bake at 428°F (220°C) for 30 minutes. Prepare the mozzarella during this bake.
Meanwhile, cut the fiordilatte and let it drain in a colander.
After the first bake, add the drained mozzarella and bake for another 10 minutes.
Finish with basil and a pinch of black pepper.
